title: Luminita 1

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: You know, I'm actually quite glad I got a shot of that taste enhancer. CorpSec have been sniffing around. Speaking of which, take a little step back there would you bud?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know, I'm actually quite glad I got a shot of that taste enhancer. CorpSec have been sniffing around. Speaking of which, take a little step back there would you bud?

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Oh by CORA no! I have bucket-loads. That one was just the most dangerous I've seen in ages.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh by CORA no! I have bucket-loads. That one was just the most dangerous I've seen in ages.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Most enhancements are perfectly safe. Always have been. Just there to add a little flavor, but the corps put an end to that quickly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Most enhancements are perfectly safe. Always have been. Just there to add a little flavor, but the corps put an end to that quickly.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Same reason they always do. Profit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Same reason they always do. Profit.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: It's a risk vs reward thing. I'm big on the reward, and experienced enough not to fuck with the risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a risk vs reward thing. I'm big on the reward, and experienced enough not to fuck with the risk.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: What and let Curzona win? I don't think so. They need me as much as I need them. It's an ecosystem.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What and let Curzona win? I don't think so. They need me as much as I need them. It's an ecosystem.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Interesting? Maybe. Profitable? Big fucking time pal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting? Maybe. Profitable? Big fucking time pal.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: You know what I don't remember? Existing in the void and asking to be born into this corrupt, bent society where people with bad breath bother me all day. I'm playing the hand I was dealt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know what I don't remember? Existing in the void and asking to be born into this corrupt, bent society where people with bad breath bother me all day. I'm playing the hand I was dealt.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: I'd be well and truly boned my friend. Good job Curzona will never do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd be well and truly boned my friend. Good job Curzona will never do it.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: You know just the other day, some guy came to me and asked if I could find him the synthesized flavor of the birthday cake his mother made for him as a child.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know just the other day, some guy came to me and asked if I could find him the synthesized flavor of the birthday cake his mother made for him as a child.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: You're goddamn right I did. Had to mix a few things but the look in his eye when he tried it... he was back there, sat on her lap again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're goddamn right I did. Had to mix a few things but the look in his eye when he tried it... he was back there, sat on her lap again.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Didn't give me his name. Tall, intense, weird voice.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn't give me his name. Tall, intense, weird voice.

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Exactly!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Luminita Roe
nodes.text: Curzona worked out a long time ago that if you make something illegal, people will pay over the odds for it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Curzona worked out a long time ago that if you make something illegal, people will pay over the odds for it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Was that your last one?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Was that your last one?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are taste enhancements illegal?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are taste enhancements illegal?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should probably stop what you're doing if it's against the law.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should probably stop what you're doing if it's against the law.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You should probably stop what you're doing if it's against the law.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You should probably stop what you're doing if it's against the law.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Sounds like an interesting business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sounds like an interesting business.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It feels like you're enabling Curzona to do what they do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It feels like you're enabling Curzona to do what they do.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It feels like you're enabling Curzona to do what they do.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It feels like you're enabling Curzona to do what they do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What if taste enhancers were legalized?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What if taste enhancers were legalized?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What if taste enhancers were legalized?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What if taste enhancers were legalized?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You could be a productive member of society.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You could be a productive member of society.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You could be a productive member of society.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You could be a productive member of society.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: The Miso Baron?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The Miso Baron?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Illegality makes money!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Illegality makes money!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fuck Curzona!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fuck Curzona!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Clever, actually!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Clever, actually!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you remember his name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you remember his name?
